title: [4.4RC1] Label text randomly missing on Editor on low end Android device
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4.RC1, 4.4.dev [65e9d5e5e4c3e0904fdc9c93a3ff3a8b18021210]
- Not reproducible in: 4.3.stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc1 - Android - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3 (Compatibility) - PowerVR Rogue GE8320 -  (8 threads)

### Issue description

- Missing text on Project Manager's project

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1778e8c0-179d-4523-875f-bdd8b4ee3033)

- Missing text from Project Manager's Quick Settings

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/83262d95-ad2d-4bff-bc99-3aaedaa2e491)

- Missing text on Export Template Manager

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/128e6533-9813-4685-b5d8-9f2ea58d860a)

- Missing "Patrons" and "Platinum Sponsors" text on the Donors page of About Godot window

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/41591e23-0127-4124-95ba-04f92ef58df3)

- I forgot what triggered this error

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bf8015bc-7843-4677-83c8-40e468920df0)

---

The issue is **not** reproducible on Godot v4.4.rc1 on this mid end device from the same product lineup (Redmi 9)⬇️.
`Godot v4.4.rc (c54b50cac) - Android - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3 (Compatibility) - Mali-G52 -  (8 threads)`

### Steps to reproduce

- Have a low end Android device (preferably one that has 32 bit OS)
- Open the editor
- Notices several places with missing text/graphics, notably
- - Project Manager
- - Export Template Manager
- - About Godot window
- - Warning popup

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
